semiconductor_relevance: High — Comcraft specializes in high-voltage and high-frequency components essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Comcraft is a trading company with over 40 years of experience, focusing on high-voltage and high-frequency components for the semiconductor industry. They offer products such as vacuum capacitors and high-voltage vacuum relays, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: High-voltage vacuum relays for DC/RF switching

regional_presence.United States: Comcraft operates as a trading company in the US market.
regional_presence.Europe: Comcraft has a presence in the European electronics components market.
